primary_goal: All actually released official StoneAge franchise pets across regional official versions, including limited, sold and fused forms; private server only additions excluded
in_game_release_gate: actual release/availability in qualified official operator version backed by version-specific official announcement/update, reward/opening evidence, or qualified original version gameplay and ID evidence; web marketing/gallery alone does not close this gate

evidence_summary.note: Zero is the count of in-game release proofs obtained FROM THESE WEB-ONLY RECORDS, not the number of official pets historically released

identity_rule: Count separate species and variants/skins/evolved/fusion output with distinct keys, and deduplicate across operator/versions only with primary identity evidence; identical names, sprites or numeric IDs alone are insufficient
future_original_pet_design_rule: Future local offline new-game original pets belong in separate DESIGN_FUTURE catalogue; never merged into historical official release facts
source_media_rights: No original commercial image, sprite, server corpus or binaries published by default; file SHA and licensed source metadata only
next: PET-OFFICIAL-01 official release proof/region-version census, prioritize Mainland zodiac/commercial and later fusion, then Taiwan/Japan/Korea official records, then qualified official assets and stats
